answer: Because the wander burn is entered at the harbor settlement, the signal audit makes public the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. 90% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
